additional_context: FHIR-13034 is a later Published/Persuasive duplicate tracker for the same pluralization. The Device resource is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Device introduction has since been rewritten while retaining the corrected grammar.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Device Scope and Usage paragraph says "This is a base resource..." and "It is referenced by other resources...", satisfying both requested typo corrections.
